project_name: Personal Expense Tracker — Finance & Intelligence Platform
purpose: A production-grade personal financial management and intelligence web platform providing multi-criteria transaction auditing, dynamic category budgeting with progressive alerts, multi-dimensional Plotly financial analytics, Scikit-learn machine learning expense forecasting, 50/30/20 rule intelligence, savings goals tracking, and automated multi-page PDF executive reporting.
primary_users: Working professionals and executives managing personal budgets and savings rates
Freelancers and contractors tracking fluctuating multi-stream income and project cashflows
Household financial managers monitoring family living expenses against category spending caps
Students and young adults learning disciplined 50/30/20 budgeting and debt/savings allocation
frameworks: Custom Vanilla CSS & Glassmorphism Design System
Plotly Express & Graph Objects (Data Visualization Engine)

inference_outputs: predicted_total (Point estimate for next month total expenditure)
confidence_interval_95 (Residual standard error bounds: lower_bound to upper_bound)
cat_predictions (Weighted moving average: 60% recent month + 40% historical mean)
ai_components.input_guardrails: Enforces minimum 5 expense transactions across at least 2 distinct calendar months before fitting

techniques: 50/30/20 Standard Financial Rule Evaluator (Needs vs Wants vs Savings)
Category Spending Spike Anomaly Detector (>25% surge vs 3-month rolling average)
Recurring Subscription Auditor (Aggregates fixed subscription charges & flags optimization opportunities)
Financial Health Score Index (0-100 score weighted across savings rate, expense-to-income ratio, and budget adherence)

databases.connection_mode: psycopg2-binary via Transaction Pooler (port 6543) or Direct (port 5432)
databases.wrapper: PgConnectionWrapper & PgCursorWrapper with SQLite dialect query translation and RETURNING id injection

databases.mode: WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) with 30s timeout and multi-thread support
databases.role: Offline-first development and automated connection error fallback

database_tables: users (id, username, full_name, email, password_hash, salt, currency, theme, created_at)
categories (id, user_id, name, type, icon, color, UNIQUE(user_id, name, type))
transactions (id, user_id, date, type, category, amount, payment_method, notes, is_recurring, recurring_frequency, created_at)
budgets (id, user_id, category, monthly_limit, year_month, created_at, UNIQUE(user_id, category, year_month))
savings_goals (id, user_id, name, target_amount, current_amount, target_date, status, notes, created_at)
external_services: Supabase Cloud Database (PostgreSQL hosting & transaction pooler)
Google Fonts CDN (Plus Jakarta Sans & JetBrains Mono typography)
Streamlit Community Cloud (Production application hosting platform)
deployment_platform: Streamlit Community Cloud (share.streamlit.io) / Local Streamlit Server (Uvicorn / WebSockets)

major_modules.role: Application entrypoint, page routing, authentication gating, sidebar navigation, dynamic CSS injection
Dual-engine database layer, SQLite-to-Postgres dialect wrappers, schema migrations, demo data seeders
Salted PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 password hashing (100k rounds), registration, login, 1-click instant demo access
Executive financial KPI cards, Financial Health Score (0-100), income vs expense trends, spending pie chart
Transaction ledger CRUD, multi-criteria filtering, single-row selection callback, recurring expenses tracker
Monthly category spending caps, real-time progress bars, multi-tier budget alerts (<75%, 75-99%, >=100%)
Plotly interactive analytics: grouped bars, cumulative cashflow line, box plot outlier detection, treemap, heatmap
Scikit-learn time-series forecasting, next-month point estimate, 95% confidence bounds, category prediction
50/30/20 compliance auditor, category spending surge detector (>25% vs 3-month avg), rule-based financial advice
Financial milestones tracker, target completion dates, popover deposit logging, progress indicators
Batch CSV/XLSX file ingestion with schema validation, CSV/XLSX export, branded multi-page FPDF2 PDF generation
User profile management, currency selector (USD, EUR, GBP, INR, JPY, CAD, AUD), theme toggle, data reset
Fintech design system: deep navy dark theme, elevated card hierarchy, glowing borders, custom Plotly layouts
Currency formatting, PDF Latin-1 sanitization, category icons/colors map, year-month string formatters

major_workflows: Financial Ingestion & Interactive Single-Row Audit Workflow
Active Budget Monitoring & Progressive Alerting Workflow
Multi-Dimensional Plotly Visual Analytics & Outlier Detection
Machine Learning Next-Month Expense Forecasting & Confidence Intervals
Smart 50/30/20 Financial Intelligence & Anomaly Spike Detection
Wealth Goal Milestones & Deposit Accumulation Workflow
Batch Data Import & Multi-Page Branded PDF Report Generation

verified_limitations: Remote Supabase connection failure triggers graceful fallback to SQLite, but remote DNS resolution failed on this host
Credentials were committed in local .env rather than loaded exclusively via environment variables or secret vaults
Streamlit session state is tab/browser scoped; browser refreshes without query parameters reset session unless user stays authenticated in session
Scikit-learn model retrains synchronously on page load rather than using asynchronous worker queues or serialized model artifacts
Single-row dataframe selection requires table rerun cycle which can induce brief Streamlit widget rehydration delay
No multi-factor authentication (MFA) or email verification service currently integrated into registration flow
